subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What single Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract should own the remaining #50291 fields across lifecycle, message, and subagent hooks?
rationale: Current main has partial runId and trace-carrier pieces, but deciding whether to add agent_start, flat span fields, outbound run correlation, and requester/child run ids is a public plugin API design choice.

options.title: Design one additive hook contract
options.body: Define the supported fields once, reconcile #80551 and #18571 into that contract, then implement the agreed API with docs and tests.

options.title: Keep narrower issues separate
options.body: Leave #50291 as the umbrella while implementing only the agent_start and outbound-message slices through their narrower open issues.

options.title: Defer core changes
options.body: Close or pause the umbrella if maintainers decide current diagnostics and hook fields are enough for plugins for now.

recommendation.title: Design one additive hook contract
recommendation.body: Define the supported fields once, reconcile #80551 and #18571 into that contract, then implement the agreed API with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged trace carrier foundation and adjacent hook correlation history most directly connected to the API decision.
